prompts.message: Infill patterns are typically designed to handle rotation automatically to ensure proper printing and achieve their intended effects (e.g., Gyroid, Cubic). Rotating the current sparse infill pattern may lead to insufficient support. Please proceed with caution and thoroughly check for any potential printing issues. Are you sure you want to enable this option?
